snippet.title: Brawlhalla X Year of Shadow Launch (mod) Trailer
snippet.description:
Celebrating the Year of Shadow the Hedgehog is back and he isn't done cleaning up Sonic's mess in Brawlhalla! This crossover mod see's a full rework of our original Shadow/Cross!

Shadow's Reveal Trailer: https://youtu.be/WlOUJLpi5rk
Download Shadow Rework mod – https://gamebanana.com/mods/479967
